Edward Molony (5 September 2009) is a British actor and singer, and the brother of fellow actor Alexander Molony. In 2016, he acted in the Comedy horror TV series Crazyhead.
Acting career
Screen acting
In 2016, Molony played the character Tom in the TV series Crazyhead, directed by Al Mackay and Declan O'Dwyer. The show received mixed reviews and was not renewed for a second season. In 2018, Molony acted in the Jasper Enjuba short film, Estranged. Furthermore, he appeared as himself in the documentary The CFF Story, which was about the Children's Film Foundation.
Voice-over work
From 2019-20, Molony voice acted as a recurring role, 'Buster Bunker', in Ricky Zoom, a Nickolodeon TV series.
Music career
Stage
In 2024, Molony took on the boy soprano part of Gherardino Donati in a production of Puccini's Gianni Schicchi at Grange Park Opera in a double bill with Bryn Terfel. The production was very well received, with the ensemble cast also garnering high praise.
Film
In 2023, Molony sung on the critically acclaimed soundtracks of the films The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes and ''Five Nights at Freddy's by James Newton Howard and The Newton Brothers respectively.
